primary: Historical no-cart1.5 versus NEW no-cart1.5, exact runtime config equality
secondary: NEW no-cart1.5 versus recent no-cart1.0, same current host; single-run descriptive comparison
physical_progress_bins: 1m approach world-Y bins [2,3)..[9,10), robot X east of original corner exit; precontact only
divergence_inspection: First of two consecutive common approach-Y bins where both median applied angular-command sign and median native-lookahead-left sign disagree between historical and new1.5; original numerical sign tolerances. This descriptive persistence rule is not a significance/causality threshold. Export all bins. If absent, state not identified and show first corner-region observation as inspection only.
selected_observation: Observation nearest bin center in world Y within that bin, no same-C-index matching; differences in X/yaw/history retained
corner_inspection: First precontact FRESH observation inside original corner entry region, as in prior saved analysis
reasoning: Preserve saved reasoning text, start/poll steps, delay reference, sampled image IDs, state tokens and previous-motion prompt. No exact KV-state identity or worker-ready time inferred when absent.
